name: Koko wa Rakuensou 3
source:
His girlfriend from #1 came back. Now what is he going to do since he already has a girlfriend from #2. He will have to decide which one he wants, but in the mean time, he still enjoys the girls around him. This time, he can pick one of two girlfriends or stay the same as before.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
第一作中的女友回来了，可他已经有了第二作中的女友，现在该怎么办？他必须决定自己究竟想和谁在一起；不过在作出选择前，他仍然享受着身边少女们的陪伴。这一次，玩家可以从两名女友中选择一人，也可以维持过去的状态。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161210003249/http://www.members.shaw.ca/lisun/jhag-wng.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
